biotools.summary: prepR4pcm is an R package designed for preparing data and phylogenetic trees for comparative methods, particularly by reconciling species names through staged matching procedures. It ensures that species names in trait datasets align correctly with tip labels in phylogenetic trees, mitigating common naming mismatches.
